About: Kickoff time templates for the guided tour. LFF_GoldenPath.json is the 1:00 PM tour; each template changes only the steps whose times, copy or order differ for its kickoff time, and each game fills in its opponent and date. Times are Eastern. Voice lines for changed cards are named <base line>__<template Id> (or __g<game date> for the cards that name the opponent) and are made by Tools/Audio/make_kickoff_vo.py.
